newsitem.title: JAPAN: Shares of Asahi Homes suspended - JSDA.
newsitem.headline: Shares of Asahi Homes suspended - JSDA.

text.p: Trading of Asahi Homes Co Ltd's shares was suspended in over-the-counter (OTC) trade on Tuesday afternoon, the Japan Securities Dealers' Association (JSDA) said.
JSDA said it suspended trading in Asahi because information about the firm was spreading and the association needed to confirm the information.
Japanese financial daily, Nihon Keizai Shimbun, said on Tuesday that 10 financial institutions had agreed to give up 4.2 billion yen worth of Asahi debt.
